statement: AI data-center power is becoming a binding constraint: Gartner projects 40% of AI data centers power-constrained by 2027 as global DC electricity roughly doubles from ~485 TWh (2025) to ~950 TWh.
why: Power availability is emerging as a hard ceiling on AI compute deployment, throttling how much GPU capacity can be brought online.

impact.mechanism: Grid and power-equipment shortfalls cap datacenter buildout, constraining the supply of deployable GPU capacity.

evidence.excerpt: 40% of AI data centers will be power-constrained by 2027

confidence.basis: Secondary blog aggregating Deloitte/Gartner figures within a single document.
